title: COMPARE-SCHEMA-V1
description: Protected comparison response schema. Architecture 16.4. Validated in Java after the provider's structured-output pass, because provider structured output is best effort and this contract is not.

requirementId.description: Echoed back so a provider mix-up or a successful injection is detectable.

gapType.description: PARTIAL only. Elsewhere it misleads a reviewer into reading a MISSING requirement as merely weaker.

standardSpanIds.description: Span IDs only. Never a quotation: a quoted string must be re-located in the document, and that is where fabricated evidence enters.
